description.value: Established in 1983, Chilliwack River Rafting is British Columbia's first whitewater rafting resort, operating on a 5-acre private property nestled in the Cascade Mountains alongside the Chilliwack River, roughly 90 minutes from Vancouver. The operation offers guided paddle raft trips ranging from family-friendly Class 2 floats to continuous Class 4+ canyon runs, plus sit-on-top inflatable kayaking. The on-site Raft Ranch includes camping, a cookhouse serving hearty buffet meals, showers, beach volleyball, and fire pits, making it a self-contained outdoor adventure destination.
